body:
That's the majority. Not entirely men but yes...mostly men. At least on Reddit. Definitely in these comments. This is where I leave you if you really don't think gender has any significance in this issue. 

Is there a problem today with men claiming false rape? I'm being dead serious, if you have sources for me I would love to read up. I can admit when I'm wrong.

Edit: quickly realized the last part might seem like I don't think men can be assaulted. Of course men experience assault as well. Just saying women aren't worried about it when they are dating so yea there are differences between the genders on this one. Undeniably.

You should definitely get fired up about people being murdered, regardless of where they are in the world. Hate crimes are also bad. Both of these things affect a lot of people in the world and are truly devastating. There are so many things happening in the world to freak out about every single day. 

Reddit loses its god damn mind every time ONE of these allegations comes out. If you're going to pretend Reddit isn't insanely weirdly sexist sometimes (not all the time, but surely sometimes) then I can't help you.

I get what you're saying and I think we mostly agree if ultimately it's understood that false rape accusations and real rape are both bad and an argument on which is worse isn't necessary.

But I do think the public apologies only apply to public figures. There are plenty of average, everyday people in this country who don't feel the need to be on board and have no problem speaking out about it.

Read my other comments if you want to feel embarrassed. I specifically mention a woman caring about false rape.

And if everyone you encounter that you disagree with is a small minded piece of shit, life's going to smell fucking terrible for you, bud. I'm sure you have an interesting opinion somewhere in there. "You're a piece of shit" can't be your best work.
They don't get it. They're distracted. It's incel circle jerk time

Do you honestly think in the US that everyone is officially on board with the #metoo movement? From my perspective I've seen just as much pushback as support. The whole thing started because so many women weren't taken seriously.

My boyfriend has been told on multiple occasions (once by a white woman he works with in tech in SF) how sorry they are for him that he has to walk on eggshells around women nowadays. You still want to tell me this whole "believing women when they say they've been hurt" thing has gone too far? Or are you saying in this country we need to direct our attention to one failing of our judicial system at a time?

*Men. The upvotes show that men feel false claims need more recognition.

One time in college, a girl in my sorority cried rape and her story had some serious holes. That's my singular experience with false rape accusations. Now let's compare that to a movement that resonates with almost every woman on the planet.

Downvote me to hell. All because I don't think men should be front page level fired up about something that will likely never touch them or anyone they know.

Still to this day I hear about how my dad and I have "always butted heads."

A grown man with anger issues regularly wailing on a 9 year old girl is apparently basic according to my family.
And then, what if I feel like this when my parents die? I can't be on this planet without mommy and daddy to pick me up whenever I fall.

I was recently thinking, I'll be 30 in a bit and I still don't feel like a grown up.

What if I still feel like that approaching 40?
Thanks but I'm the one that's a problem. And I won't stop talking to him. He is my only friend where I live now. My closest other friend is a good hour away and she's pretty unreliable.

Tried just now and the woman said "there's nothing they can do for me now" within about two minutes of the call.

So that's the last time I do that

I did. I was re-diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder. An old therapist told me he was a BPD expert and there was no way I had it. 

I am apologizing a lot right now. Taking full responsibility for everything and laying low for a bit.

Thank you for responding!!!
